name: Timeline findings preview stays open while its findings scroll
description: Regression flow for the findings preview closing as soon as its own list scrolled: a capture-phase page-scroll listener heard the list's scroll event. The seed has no completed agent run, so before opening PR #482 the flow stubs, in this page only, the two read-only GETs the Timeline reads (/pulls/:id/runs and /pulls/:id/reviews) with one finished Security Reviewer run of 3 Critical and 2 Warning findings — no write and no model call. agent-browser 0.27's `network route --body` did not intercept these API calls, so the stub replaces window.fetch; the soft navigation into the PR keeps it, and the next flow's `open` starts a fresh document without it. The 760px viewport clamps the preview's left edge to x=392, so its findings scrollbar is at x=734 whatever the fonts; a precondition step checks the scrollbar thumb is under the pointer before the real mouse drag. agent-browser's `mouse wheel` always fires at (0,0), so the in-place scroll uses `scroll --selector`, which scrolls the list and fires the same native scroll event a wheel does; the keyboard check pages the list with a real PageDown. Finally, leaving the counters and preview, Tabbing out of it, and scrolling the page each still close it.

'security' : 'bug', title: i === 4 ? 'Last previewed finding' : 'Previewed finding ' + (i + 1), file: 'src/api/limiter.ts', start_line: 10 + i, end_line: 10 + i, rationale: 'Stubbed finding for the findings preview scroll flow.', confidence: 0.9, accepted_at: null, dismissed_at: null })); const stubs = { runs: [{ run_id: 'e2e-run', agent_id: null, agent_name: 'Security Reviewer', provider: 'openrouter', model: 'e2e/stub', status: 'done', error: null, duration_ms: 1000, tokens_in: 100, tokens_out: 50, cost_usd: 0.001, findings_count: 5, severity_counts: { CRITICAL: 3, WARNING: 2, SUGGESTION: 0 }, grounding: '5/5 passed', ran_at: '2026-10-19T12:00:00.000Z', score: 0, blockers: 3 }], reviews: [{ id: 'e2e-review', pr_id: 'e2e-pr', agent_id: null, run_id: 'e2e-run', agent_name: 'Security Reviewer', kind: 'review', verdict: 'request_changes', summary: 'Stubbed review for the findings preview scroll flow.', score: 0, cost_usd: 0.001, model: 'e2e/stub', created_at: '2026-10-19T12:00:00.000Z', findings }] }; const realFetch = window.fetch.bind(window); window.fetch = (input, init) => { const parts = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), location.href).pathname.split('/'); const body = parts.length === 4 && parts[1] === 'pulls' && Object.hasOwn(stubs, parts[3]) ? stubs[parts[3]] : null; return body ? Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } })) : realFetch(input, init); }; return 'fetch stubbed'; })()
